symptom_from_metrics.description: P50/P95 latency tang khoang 17 lan so voi baseline sau khi bat incident rag_slow, vuot han latency_threshold_ms=2000 quy dinh trong config/challenge.json.

root_cause: app/mock_rag.py dong 18: retrieve() goi time.sleep(2.5) khi STATE['rag_slow'] duoc bat. Day la nguyen nhan duy nhat cua do tre them ~2.5s tren moi request thuoc feature 'refund' (va cac feature khac dung RAG).
trace_limitation: Trace Langfuse chi co 1 span 'run' gop chung buoc RAG retrieval va LLM generation (khong tach span rieng), nen khong the doc truc tiep tu waterfall ra RAG la nguyen nhan -- phai doi chieu voi so sanh latency baseline/incident va code review.
fix_action: Tat incident bang scripts/inject_incident.py --scenario rag_slow --disable (da thuc hien). Ve lau dai: them timeout/circuit breaker cho buoc retrieve() va tach rieng span RAG trong tracing de phat hien nhanh hon.
preventive_measure: Them alert rieng cho P95 latency cua feature 'refund' (hoac tung feature dung RAG) vuot 2000ms trong config/alert_rules.yaml, va tach span RAG rieng trong app/agent.py de trace waterfall the hien ro buoc nao cham.
